notes: Fixes the connection flapping: the app no longer counts a camera that is busy recording as a lost camera, so it stays connected through every capture and camera test. The camera test now records for a real 3 seconds instead of 32, and its clip is not analysed as a shot. Live view: the camera's stream turned out to be MPEG-TS wrapped in a 12 byte header; the app now strips it. Apply camera settings and Test camera are disabled while the camera is busy, and Apply says so instead of failing four times.
